title: 9 Best Green Tea Desserts in Boseong
description: The best green tea desserts in Boseong — Korea's tea capital. Matcha soft serve, bingsu, roll cakes & more at plantation cafés. Interactive map included.

redditQuotes.text: I had lunch at Cafe Min which was delicious. I was glad the shop and cafe were open in December.
redditQuotes.source: — r/koreatravel · Daehan Tea Plantation Trip Report, Jan 2024

redditQuotes.text: Treat yourself to some green tea ice cream once you've made it back down. It's seriously my favorite thing ever.
redditQuotes.source: — travel blog · Boseong Green Tea Fields guide

redditQuotes.text: The cafe sells many tea drinks not to mention green tea ice cream. It was delicious and more like soft serve than the traditional ice cream most of us think of.
Boseong Matcha is a globally competitive product in terms of taste, aroma, and quality.
redditQuotes.source: — local news · Asia Business Daily, Jul 2025

redditQuotes.text: The Greendahyang cafe has become a must-visit spot for social media photos — smooth taste, rich aroma, and visually appealing presentation.
redditQuotes.source: — local coverage · Boseong Matcha-core trend piece

redditQuotes.text: The green tea soft serve here did cost less than the soft serve once in the plantation. We took our walk up to the plantation with green tea soft serves in hand.
redditQuotes.source: — travel blog · Boseong Green Tea Fields and That Dessert Shot

redditQuotes.text: If you want it cheaper, then actually wait until you get out to the parking lot. There's a mini shop and the ice cream was only 2,000 KRW there vs. the 3,500 KRW at the cafeteria.
redditQuotes.source: — travel blog · Boseong Green Tea Fields: Everything You Need to Know

places.name: The World of Spreading Green Leaves (초록잎이 펼치는 세상)

redditQuotes.text: There were some particularly pretty photos we had seen of trays of green tea desserts set against a backdrop of sloping tea fields, and we hoped to find that location.
redditQuotes.source: — travel blog · Boseong Green Tea Fields and That Dessert Shot

redditQuotes.text: The interior was set up like a quite classical tea room, with wooden floors and low tables that you sat on the floor to eat at.
After I came back down again, I had time to check out the gift shop and have lunch at Cafe Min (which was delicious). I was glad the shop and cafe were open in December.
redditQuotes.source: — r/koreatravel · Daehan Tea Plantation Trip Report

redditQuotes.text: There is a beautiful pond, a welcoming cafe-restaurant, and a shop selling tea and souvenirs.
redditQuotes.source: — travel blog · Kavey Eats — Visiting Boseong

redditQuotes.text: A great next stop if you want to learn more about the history of tea in Korea and try a wider range of exceptional teas. You'll find a museum exhibit showcasing how tea is grown and processed, a cafe with wonderful views.
redditQuotes.source: — travel blog · Kavey Eats — Visiting Boseong

places.name: Daehan Dawon Green Tea Restaurant (대한다원 식당)

redditQuotes.text: We ordered the green tea bibimbap, and the green tea jjajangmyeon. These were sadly bland, not standout dishes, and the green tea components were not particularly discernible. They came across as touristy gimmick dishes.
There was an eatery in the middle of Daehan Dawon. Really the only food option there.
